message.content:
Layout: Inconsistent button sizing in the right sidebar (e.g., "Top" vs. "Reset") - Medium.  
Contrast: "Guest Mode — Limited features" tooltip text has low contrast against its background - Medium.  
Typography: "Edit Ceiling Lights" label is smaller than other sidebar text, reducing hierarchy - Low.  
Spacing: Insufficient padding between "Design Skins" section and the "Skeleton" card - Low.  
Buttons: "Capture" button in the right sidebar lacks clear visual distinction from other buttons - Medium.
